en.content: Identify the incorrect statement for PCl5 from the following.

options.content: In this molecule, orbitals of phosphorous are assumed to undergo sp<sup>3</sup>d hybridization.
The geometry of PCl<sub>5</sub> is trigonal bipyramidal.
PCl<sub>5</sub> has two axial bonds stronger than three equatorial bonds.
The three equatorial bonds of PCl<sub>5</sub> lie in a plane.

en.explanation:
PCl5


All three equatorial bonds in a plane

sp3d hybridization

Trigonal bipyramidal

Axial bonds are weaker than equatorial bonds.

en.content: The correct order of increasing intermolecular hydrogen bond strength is :

options.content: HCN < H<sub>2</sub>O < NH<sub>3</sub>
HCN < CH<sub>4</sub> < NH<sub>3</sub>
CH<sub>4</sub> < HCN < NH<sub>3</sub>
CH<sub>4</sub> < NH<sub>3</sub> < HCN

en.explanation:
Due to the high difference in electronegativity of H and N the H-bond strength of NH3 is highest. There is no H-bond in CH4.

CH4 < HCN < NH3

en.content:
Given below are two statements : one is labelled as Assertion A and the other is labelled as Reason R.

Assertion A : Fluorine forms one oxoacid.

Reason R : Fluorine has smallest size amongst all halogens and is highly electronegative.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below :

options.content: Both A and R are correct and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are correct but R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
A is correct but R is not correct.
A is not correct but R is correct.

en.explanation:
Due to its smaller size, fluorine forms only one oxoacid.

Both the Assertion and Reason are correct and The reason is the correct explanation.
